name: manager-skills
description: Management & communication skills — executive writing and reporting tools. The report family — report-brief (a tight decision brief), report-progress (progress / status update), report-state (a state-of report), report-strategic (a strategic brief) — plus resume-author (resumes / CVs). Writing tools for leadership communication: exec summaries, status, briefs. Skills only — no commands, agents, or MCP. Self-contained.
